description: Opt in preset: regenerates web/pnpm-lock.yaml for the govue npm dependency that a regex custom manager finds, since Renovate regenerates no lock file for a custom manager. The command must equal the one pattern in RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS of reusable-renovate.yaml.

packageRules.description: Regenerate the pnpm lock file of web/ for the govue custom manager dependency, without project scripts and without the project pnpmfile. Commits only web/pnpm-lock.yaml.
